title: descurainia nuttallii
intro: Descurainia nuttallii, commonly known as western wallflower or nuttall's wallflower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a biennial plant native to the western United States and Canada, known for its bright yellow flowers. The health benefits of Descurainia nuttallii include its ability to aid in the treatment of anxiety and stress due to its adaptogenic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isothiocyanates and flavonoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
